title: Publish a file on a web server
description: Reads a Storage file in base64, uploads it with ssh_upload_v1 to the explicit ssh target and path of the caller, and checks the returned SHA-256. The journal is written at requested before the upload. Requires a manual confirmation.

publication_id.description: Publication identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Derived from the request when absent; also the idempotency key of a social post

source_path.description: Absolute Storage path of the file

target.description: Name of the published ssh target

remote_path.description: Path relative to the publication root of the target

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing remote file (default no)

confirmation_manuelle.description: Manual confirmation: oui (or true) to proceed

resend_after_unknown.description: oui to send again a publication whose outcome is unknown (requested or outcome_unknown); noted in the history

attempt.description: Attempt number (2 to 99) appended to a derived publication_id, to publish the same request again after a removal
